pkgmetadata.longdescription: mcp-victoriametrics is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for VictoriaMetrics: metrics query and analysis over PromQL/ MetricsQL, configured entirely via MCP_* and VMC_* environment variables (no CLI flag framework upstream). Builds from the self-contained source tarball - the tag commits a full vendor/ tree (71 modules), so no deps hosting is needed.
